concept.hr: _ldap._tcp, _kerberos._tcp, _msdcs; što se pokvari kad ih nema
concept.en: _ldap._tcp, _kerberos._tcp, _msdcs; what breaks when they are missing

summary.hr: Kontroleri domene upisuju SRV zapise za LDAP, Kerberos i lokacije. Obriši ih ili pitaj javni DNS: učlanjenje i prijava ne uspijevaju; Netlogon ih vraća.
summary.en: Domain controllers register SRV records for LDAP, Kerberos and sites. Delete them or ask a public DNS: join and logon fail; Netlogon puts them back.
